description: This file defines the NodeForegroundService class, which manages foreground service behavior, notifications, and runtime status updates for an Android app related to 'OpenClaw'. It includes service lifecycle management, notification setup, and coroutine-based status updates.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: A service that runs in the foreground, managing notifications and runtime status for the OpenClaw node.

classes.name: Quint
classes.description: A data class representing a quintuple of runtime status properties.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notification channel, starts foreground with initial notification, and launches a coroutine to update notifications based on runtime status.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands; stops the service if ACTION_STOP is received.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutine jobs and scope when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null, as binding is not supported.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel for connection status if not already created.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Builds a notification with provided title and text, including actions for launching app and stopping service.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Updates the notification displayed by the system.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts the foreground service with a notification, updating if already started.
